segments.text: In the astral world, we must keep rising through dimensions. If we stop progressing and become stagnant at one level, we will start falling. For example, if someone reaches the 7 crore dimension, gains access to everything, and decides to relax and enjoy their achievements instead of continuing to rise, they will begin to fall back down.
Why can’t a person stop at a particular dimension? Why he has to rise dimensions rigorously?
– There are multiple factors behind it as follows :-

In science the level of earth is considered zero & in astral world earth has a tendency where it tries to bring everything to zero or neutral. If you are in positive or negative dimension, it will try to bring you to zero state.

If you reach the 7 crore dimension and decide to stop progressing to enjoy the privileges, others who are still rising will eventually surpass you. When someone reaches your level and continues moving up, while rising to higher dimension he will attack on you & will push you down to the 7 crore -1 dimension while he will advance to the 7 crore +1 dimension.
To see the above factor, one has to have a advance level drishti to see who is attacking you otherwise with lower level drishti a person will only be able to see rising or falling of dimensions.

When the saints saw that its rat race so they decided not to participate in it & instead to rise dimensions upwards they decided to rise dimensions downwards which is below the earth zero level & the competition is also less there. They sacrifice everything & do little bit of chanting & give priority to concentration & with the help of it their astral body activates but don’t rise dimensions.

Earth has 7 lokas above & below of its zero level. There are different advantages of both the upward & downward dimensions & both are equally good. So the saints through concentration go downwards & there also they gain energy & rise dimensions downwards. To rise more dimensions they need more force to go downwards & simultaneously the earth tries to pull them back to zero level, so going downwards has its own disadvantages.

Some people decide neither to rise upward or downward, they want to stay at zero level. But that is also not easy as either they will get pulled upwards or downwards & can not be constant, only Lord Shiva is constant at zero level and this zero level or place is also known as “Moksha” (mukti). And if someone from ashaeiynn asks for moksha then first of all bhaiya ji will get the ancestral oblation (pind daan) done of that person & would offer a mantra along with a siddhi which will always keep you close to the zero level.
Whereas if a person has a materialistic desires & want to be at zero level than neither he will be able to fulfil his desires nor will get moksha.

It will take time & efforts to rise in both the dimensions. Ram & Vishnu tattvas are in upward dimension. In ashaeiynn also we rise dimensions upwards & our Guru tattva supreme astral body is still fully devoted to Ram tattava & is constantly rising to higher dimensions. Even today most of the deities supreme astral bodies are in meditative state & their subtle astral bodies appears for divine visions & they understood very well that they have to be in meditative state & rise dimensions continuously, otherwise they will fall dimensions & so will their devotees too because a devotee will always be at lesser dimension in comparison to his guru or deity.
To rise dimensions are we suppose to chant mantra for whole day?

For a person it is not possible because of personal commitments in his life, therefore saints introduced spiritual practice (sadhana) for specified period. So, the concept behind spiritual practice (sadhana) was to break a pattern & make new pattern by focusing on your astral body for a specified period by repetition of same mantra & energy, one of your own astral body also begins chanting the same mantra continuously, day & night. So, after practicing for first 6 months the intensity will increase significantly, that just 2 hours of your mantra chanting will charge your astral body to chant mantra 24×7 that will help you rise dimensions. And those who chant 10-12 hours on daily routine, then their supreme astral body in place of astral body starts chanting for them which result in faster rise in dimensions. So, even if you don’t chant mantra for couple of days, your dimension will not fall as for you your astral body will be chanting mantra for you.
If you have dedicated your Fifty thousand hours to mantra chanting then your supreme astral body will be activated & will be fully dedicated to chanting the mantra.
